title: Llama waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='68' rx='24' ry='17' fill='#f7e7c8'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='68' rx='24' ry='17' fill='none' stroke='#e8cfa4' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='27' y='80' width='8' height='15' rx='4' fill='#e8cfa4'/>
  <rect x='40' y='80' width='8' height='15' rx='4' fill='#f7e7c8'/>
  <rect x='53' y='80' width='8' height='15' rx='4' fill='#e8cfa4'/>
  <rect x='60' y='80' width='8' height='15' rx='4' fill='#f7e7c8'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='55' y='30' width='13' height='38' rx='6.5' fill='#f7e7c8'/>
  <rect x='55' y='30' width='5' height='38' rx='2.5' fill='#fff4dd'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='26' rx='14' ry='11' fill='#f7e7c8'/>
  <!-- ear -->
  <ellipse cx='53' cy='16' rx='3.5' ry='7' fill='#e8cfa4' transform='rotate(-15 53 16)'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='29' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#fff4dd'/>
  <ellipse cx='81' cy='28' rx='2' ry='1.6' fill='#c98f8f'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='23' r='2.2' fill='#5a4030'/>
  <circle cx='66.7' cy='22.3' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M72 33 Q75 36 79 33' stroke='#c98f8f' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- woolly fluff -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='58' r='5' fill='#fff4dd'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='56' r='6' fill='#fff4dd'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='63' r='4.5' fill='#fff4dd'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='5' fill='#fff4dd'/>
  <!-- waving arm -->
  <path d='M30 60 Q18 48 14 34' stroke='#e8cfa4' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='13' cy='30' r='6' fill='#f7e7c8'/>
  <circle cx='9' cy='24' r='2.5' fill='#fff4dd'/>
  <circle cx='17' cy='23' r='2.5' fill='#fff4dd'/>
  <circle cx='12' cy='20' r='2.5' fill='#fff4dd'/>
  <!-- other arm -->
  <path d='M66 66 Q74 70 78 78' stroke='#e8cfa4' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='64' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#fff4dd'/>
</svg>
